aliases: Local work to explicit cloud handoff (S110.22)
feature.summary: A coding session can run in a managed cloud sandbox on a GitHub repository. A local session can be handed to it from the CLI (agi code handoff) or from VS Code (Code: Continue in the Cloud), and a cloud branch can be brought back with agi resume --teleport or VS Code's Bring the branch in. It works only when managed Code is switched on. Design-to-code and review decks are not built.

purpose.what_it_does: Runs a coding agent in a cloud sandbox on a repository branch, lets the person follow it on web, mobile, CLI or VS Code, approve its steps, open a pull request, and move work between the local checkout and the cloud.
purpose.why_it_exists: The brief wants an explicit local-to-cloud hand-off, a cloud result brought into the local checkout with review, a design implemented in the user's repo and a repository turned into a review deck (doc: knowledge-base/data/area-briefs/110-cross-product-experiences-to-include-in-the-product-map.md, S110.12, S110.13, S110.22, S110.23). The cloud parity spec says cloud sessions must match Claude's (doc: docs/specs/agi-code-cloud-parity/spec.md).
purpose.who_uses_it: Developers on a plan that includes AGI Code, on a repository hosted on GitHub.
problems_solved: Long coding tasks tying up a laptop
Continuing a terminal session somewhere that keeps running
Getting a cloud branch into the local editor without copy and paste
use_cases: From the CLI: push the branch, run agi code handoff, review what moves, confirm.
In VS Code run 'Code: Continue in the Cloud', type a task, confirm the review.
On web open /code, pick a repository and start a task.
In VS Code pick a cloud session and choose 'Bring the branch in'.

where_to_find_it: Web (and desktop's hosted web app): /code page, button 'Start the task' (apps/web/app/code/page.tsx; apps/web/features/code/code-surface.ts:131).
CLI chat: /continue-with-cloud, /fork-cloud, /managed-cloud (claude_parity.rs:247-249). This is a different thing: it moves a chat transcript from Local or BYOK to Managed mode, not a code session.

VS Code: command 'Code: Continue in the Cloud' (apps/extension-vscode/package.json:592-594); the session picker has 'Continue here', 'Bring the branch in' and 'Open on web' (cloudCodeSessions.ts:81, 215-232).
Mobile: Cloud Code sessions list, new session sheet and changes sheet (apps/mobile/src/features/cloud-code/*).
prerequisites: Managed Code switched on for the deployment: AGI_E2B_EXECUTION=1, E2B_API_KEY set, compute priceable (apps/web/lib/e2b/gate.ts:6-28).
A plan that includes AGI Code (apps/web/app/api/code/sessions/route.ts:57).
Signed in to AGI Cloud; repository on GitHub with the AGI GitHub App for private repositories (code_handoff.rs access check).
CLI hand-off: session in Managed mode, branch fully pushed, run from the repository (code_push.rs:71-93; lib.rs:3209-3218).
VS Code continue: workspace has a git source with a branch (continueInCloud.ts:93-99).
screens_and_controls: CLI review screen listing what moves and what stays, then the prompt 'Hand this session to the cloud?' (lib.rs:3226-3241; code_handoff.rs:322-380).
VS Code modal with question and buttons 'Continue in the cloud' (continueInCloud.ts:21, 119-127).
VS Code info message 'Bring the branch in' with a dirty-files confirmation (context-handoff/index.ts:327, 356-381).
Web Code page: composer 'Start the task', changes panel, commit, pull request, share, archive (code-surface.ts; features/code/components).
journey: Run `agi code handoff` in the repository folder (optionally a session id).
The CLI builds the handoff record and shows what moves and what stays.
The server opens a cloud session on the pushed branch and returns a seed prompt and warnings.
The CLI runs the first cloud turn and prints the result and session link.

Later, `agi resume --teleport` in a clean checkout of the same repository fetches the session's branch, checks it out and continues with the session history (cloud/code_teleport.rs:125-175; lib.rs:2515-2519).
VS Code: run Continue in the Cloud, type the task, confirm; the extension creates the session and starts one agent turn (continueInCloud.ts:109-165).
VS Code: open a cloud session and choose 'Bring the branch in': it fetches and checks out the branch after a dirty-tree confirmation (context-handoff/index.ts:87-133).
feedback_and_outputs: CLI warns 'Uncommitted changes stay on this machine; the cloud session works from the pushed branch.' (code_push.rs:176-178).
Refusal texts for protocol, expiry, account and unknown trust mode (code_push.rs:118-133).
Server refusals: 'Managed Code is not enabled for this deployment. Use the desktop app for local code.' and 'Managed compute is temporarily unavailable...' (cloud-code-session-open.ts:44-52).
VS Code messages 'this cloud task works on <branch> in <repo>' and 'is now on <branch>' (context-handoff/index.ts:131, 360-366).
settings: VS Code setting agiWorkforce.cliPath (not for this feature).
Network access fixed to 'trusted' for CLI and VS Code starts (code_handoff.rs:11; continueInCloud.ts:146).

working: Server: open cloud session with gates on switches, workspace feature, code policy, managed compute access and plan (apps/web/lib/services/cloud-code-session-open.ts:43-160).
Server: POST /api/code/sessions/handoff admits a handoff record, maps a GitHub remote, opens the session and audits it (apps/web/app/api/code/sessions/handoff/route.ts:59-140).
CLI: agi code start and handoff with a review, push check and first turn (apps/cli/src/lib.rs:3197-3268).
CLI: agi resume --teleport brings a cloud branch and history local (lib.rs:2515-2519; cloud/code_teleport.rs:134-175). The brief says CLI cloud-to-local is missing; the code has it.
VS Code: continue in cloud creates a session from the pushed branch with a typed goal (continueInCloud.ts:93-165).
VS Code: bring-branch-in fetches and checks out with a dirty-tree confirmation (context-handoff/index.ts:87-133).
Mobile: sessions list, new session sheet, changes sheet (apps/mobile/src/features/cloud-code).
incomplete: VS Code hand-off carries no history: it creates a session from the branch plus a new task (continueInCloud.ts:142-146); this matches the decision that history comes back only when a cloud session is pulled local (doc: docs/decisions/2026-09-27-founder-decisions.md:396-403).
Bring-branch-in is a fetch and checkout, not a diff review before applying (context-handoff/index.ts:123-125); only uncommitted local files are confirmed.
CLI hand-off does not carry uncommitted changes (code_push.rs:176-178).
disconnected_or_disabled: Everything is refused unless the sandbox switches are on (cloud-code-session-open.ts:44-46; gate.ts:20-28), and the managed-compute switch is on unless set to 0 (managed-compute-gate.ts:55-58). Changes and commit routes also check e2bProvisioningReady (changes/route.ts:32; commit/route.ts:47).
not_available: S110.12 Design to implementation: no hand-off from a design or prototype to a coding session was found in apps/web/features or apps/web/lib (searches for implement-design phrasing returned nothing); the CLI decision list also rules out a design-to-code handoff (doc: docs/decisions/2026-09-27-founder-decisions.md:466-473).
S110.13 Repository review deck: no code found.
Desktop native hand-off and pull of cloud sessions: the desktop hands a cloud session to VS Code or the terminal by decision (doc: docs/decisions/2026-09-27-founder-decisions.md:342-351).
Chrome and mobile hand-off: not found.

established.statement: The user explicitly hands a local coding session (history, repo state, pending work) to cloud execution and it continues in a cloud session.
A cloud session's result (diff, branch or files) is brought into the local checkout from a product control, with review before applying.

A local session sent to the cloud starts a new cloud session from the pushed branch with a new task, as claude --cloud does; history comes back only when a cloud session is pulled local. VS Code S110.22 is met at parity once cloud sessions are on.
A cloud session's result comes local through the CLI and VS Code; the desktop app adds no native pull.
A cloud session is refused when sandbox switches are off, and when managed compute is switched off.
CLI hand-off sends only a Managed session, and refuses Local or BYOK sessions with an explanation.

acceptance_criteria: With switches off, POST /api/code/sessions returns the 'Managed Code is not enabled for this deployment' error and the VS Code and CLI actions show a refusal.
With switches on and a plan that includes AGI Code, starting a session on a repository returns a session with a branch.
agi code handoff with unpushed commits stops and tells the user to push first.
agi code handoff from a Local-mode session refuses and names /continue-with-cloud.
agi code handoff of a Managed session shows what moves and what stays, then creates a session; uncommitted changes produce the warning.
agi resume --teleport in a checkout with uncommitted changes refuses and asks to commit or stash.
In VS Code, Bring the branch in with local changes asks before switching and does nothing if declined.
In VS Code, Continue in the Cloud when signed out shows 'sign in to AGI Cloud to continue work in the cloud'.
inferred: The brief's 'review before applying' for S110.23 is met only partly by a dirty-tree confirmation; a diff view of the cloud result before checkout is not present [inferred from index.ts:87-133].
Web should show a visible reason when managed Code is off; the sessions list returns availability.deploymentEnabled and planEntitled for that (code/sessions/route.ts:57-62) [inferred use].
proposed: [proposed] Add a review step (diff summary) before Bring the branch in.
[proposed] Show the same what-moves and what-stays review on web and mobile when they gain a hand-off.
[proposed] Treat design-to-code as a record-or-build decision per app, as the CLI has already ruled it out.

steps.what_happens: CLI reads the local checkout and session, checks pushed commits, and builds the hand-off record from the saved session.
CLI shows the review, asks for confirmation, then posts the record to /api/code/sessions/handoff.
The server validates the record, maps the GitHub remote, applies every gate and opens a sandbox session on the branch.
The sandbox clones the pushed branch and runs the coding agent; steps and approvals are stored.
steps.evidence: Sandbox provider gated by apps/web/lib/e2b/gate.ts (E2B named in env var E2B_API_KEY)

steps.what_happens: The CLI runs the first cloud turn and prints the result.
To bring work back, the CLI or VS Code fetches the cloud branch from GitHub into the local checkout.

execution_and_data_flow.models_and_providers: The cloud agent model comes from the CLI --model, default.cloud_model, or an automatic coding route chosen for the plan (lib.rs cloud_code_model, about line 3170-3195); VS Code uses resolveCloudCodeAgentModel from the plan (continueInCloud.ts:116-125). Some coding agents need a managed provider credential or the user's own key, else the server refuses with a harness-credential error (cloud-code-session-open.ts:84-100).

access_and_usage.account: Signed in to AGI Cloud on every surface (CLI CloudClient::connect, continueInCloud.ts:101-106).
access_and_usage.permissions: Workspace code policy gate for act open_cloud_session and for extra hosts (cloud-code-session-open.ts:119-136); GitHub App access for private repositories (code_handoff.rs:282).
access_and_usage.subscription: Plan must include AGI Code; maximum concurrent sandboxes and sandbox lifetime come from the plan (code/sessions/route.ts:40-62; billing-catalog.ts:800-810); a daily code harness ceiling exists per plan (billing-catalog.ts:818-825).
access_and_usage.limits_and_metering: Managed compute access is evaluated per request and metered as sandbox compute (cloud-code-session-open.ts:138-148); max task length CLOUD_CODE_LIMITS (continueInCloud.ts:78-84).
access_and_usage.model_compatibility: The cloud agent needs a coding-capable route for the plan; not further established.
access_and_usage.provider_restrictions: Full internet or extra egress hosts are refused for agents whose credentials would enter the sandbox; only Trusted hosts or Isolated are allowed (cloud-code-session-open.ts:73-92).
access_and_usage.local_mode: Local mode never reaches the cloud on its own: CLI hand-off is refused for Local and BYOK sessions until the user forks into Managed with /continue-with-cloud and sends the reviewed draft (code_push.rs:71-93). The error text for web is 'Use the desktop app for local code.' (cloud-code-session-open.ts:46). Local coding on desktop needs no paid plan [inferred from AGENTS.md section 6 boundaries].

corrections.claim: A plan that includes AGI Code (apps/web/app/api/code/sessions/route.ts:57)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: route.ts:57 only computes planEntitled for the GET list response (availability, and whether runtimes are listed). The create path (handleCreate, lines 66-91) has no plan check. The plan gate for create is planIncludesAgiCode inside createCloudCodeSession, which is called from openCloudCodeSession.
corrections.correction: A plan that includes AGI Code (maxSandboxes > 0 and a code harness daily ceiling > 0). It is enforced when a session is created in cloud-code-session-service.ts:1244, and the list route only reports it as availability.planEntitled.

corrections.claim: Server open gates on switches, workspace feature, code policy, managed compute access and plan (cloud-code-session-open.ts:43-160)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The file checks e2bProvisioningReady, the beta switch, network access/proxy, harness credential, workspace feature gate, code policy gate for open_cloud_session and each extra host, and evaluateManagedComputeAccess. It has no direct plan check. It only reads entitlement.plan and passes planTier to createCloudCodeSession, which does the check.
corrections.correction: The open service applies the switches, network and credential checks, workspace and policy gates and the managed-compute access check, then hands the plan to createCloudCodeSession, which refuses a plan without AGI Code.

corrections.claim: sandbox lifetime and max concurrent sandboxes from the plan (billing-catalog.ts:800-810); daily code harness ceiling (billing-catalog.ts:818-825), and apps/web/lib/billing-catalog.ts:808-810 for getPlanSandboxTtlMs
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The behaviour is right: getPlanMaxSandboxes, getPlanSandboxTtlMs and the codeHarnessDailyCeilingCents limit exist. But the file is not at apps/web/lib/billing-catalog.ts (it does not exist). It is packages/contracts/types/src/billing-catalog.ts, with getPlanMaxSandboxes at 801, getPlanSandboxTtlMs at 808, getPlanCodeHarnessDailyCeilingCents at 827 and planIncludesAgiCode at 839-840 (maxSandboxes>0 AND ceiling>0). Several plans have maxSandboxes 0 and ceiling 0, for example the one at lines 585-596.
corrections.correction: Cite packages/contracts/types/src/billing-catalog.ts. AGI Code entitlement is maxSandboxes > 0 and a daily harness ceiling > 0.

missing_facts: The page never gives the real task length limit. continueInCloud.ts:78-84 enforces CLOUD_CODE_LIMITS.task for VS Code, and the CLI uses TASK_LIMIT = 8_000 characters and TITLE_LIMIT = 120 (apps/cli/src/cloud/code_handoff.rs:9-10). Section 7 only says 'CLOUD_CODE_LIMITS'.

Plan entitlement is not just 'basic'. Several plans (for example the one at packages/contracts/types/src/billing-catalog.ts:585-596) have maxSandboxes 0 and codeHarnessDailyCeilingCents 0, so planIncludesAgiCode is false (billing-catalog.ts:839-840). The same entitlement check also guards GET /api/code/repositories/branches (route.ts:61) and GET /api/github/repositories (route.ts:176), so a non-entitled plan cannot even list repositories. The page lists neither route, and section 7 gives no per-plan rule. Its 'Unknown' section says the planIncludesAgiCode definition was not opened.

The page puts the plan check in cloud-code-session-open.ts and route.ts:57. The enforcing check on create is createCloudCodeSession (apps/web/lib/services/cloud-code-session-service.ts:1243-1244). That is where max concurrent sandboxes (getPlanMaxSandboxes) is applied against the plan, and it is missing from the implementation map.
